Subject: Rehearsal cadence for Marketplace co-sell demo

Hi Connor —

Thanks again for partnering with CloudSplit and SIEMCO on the AWS Marketplace showcase next month. We want to lock down a short rehearsal plan so the live demo (60 mins) runs clean across APAC and NA attendees. A couple asks from our side:

- Can Redwood cover the live inference segment (10–12 mins) and confirm token cadence?
- We'd like a 30–45 minute full run-through with slides + live demo + Q&A script run-through.
- Prefer two rehearsal slots: one for APAC-friendly time and one for NA/EU.

I'm free for a quick sync tomorrow; otherwise proposing these slots (all PT):
- Wed 13 May 2026 07:00–08:00 PT (evening APAC friendly)
- Thu 14 May 2026 10:00–11:00 PT

Also attaching our draft agenda — would appreciate any notes in advance so we can consolidate with SIEMCO.

Cheers,
Amelia
Head of Partnerships | CloudSplit

From: connor_obrien@redwood.ai

Subject: Re: Rehearsal cadence for Marketplace co-sell demo

Amelia —

Thanks for the proposed windows. We're happy to own the live inference segment and will make sure the KV cache warm-up and batching settings are covered in the run-through. I uploaded an internal runbook and a demo deck for alignment (attached).

Proposed rehearsal plan (to confirm):
- Rehearsal A (APAC-friendly): Wed 13 May 2026 07:00–07:45 PT / Thu 14 May 2026 22:00–22:45 SGT (shortened run-through focused on latency and failover)
- Rehearsal B (NA/EU prep): Thu 14 May 2026 10:00–11:00 PT (full 45-minute run-through)

Agenda (45 min):
1) Intros & deck walkthrough (10 min)
2) Live inference demo: warm-up + prompt variants (12 min)
3) Failure scenarios & fallback (8 min)
4) Q&A and next steps (15 min)

Operational notes:
- We'll use a dedicated Redwood demo pool pinned to the AWS Marketplace model variant (rwd-infer-ops:v1).
- Vivek will stage a KV-cache snapshot before both rehearsals to keep latency consistent.
- Requesting SIEMCO to join the first 15 minutes to confirm integration behavior with their observability hooks.

Attachments: marketplace-demo-runbook-v2.pdf (internal runbook), cs-demo-deck-cloudsplit-v1.pptx (deck), speaker-list-roles.csv

Can you confirm which rehearsal slot Amelia prefers and whether AWS Marketplace ops should be looped for the preflight?

Best,
Connor O'Brien
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: marketplace-demo-runbook-v2.pdf, cs-demo-deck-cloudsplit-v1.pptx]

Looping in a couple operational checks. Quick points:

- Vanessa: please own the calendar invites and include the rehearsal runbook link in the invite description. Add a short preflight checklist (network, IAM, marketplace entitlement).
- Vivek: please snapshot the KV-cache and paste the artifact link into the runbook (we need the seed to reproduce token latency).
- Connor: add a 5-minute handoff slide that covers fallback routing to a lower-cost model variant if the pinned pool spikes. We'll need that in the deck.

Also: suggest we keep the APAC rehearsal as a 30-minute tight run (we can skip deep Q&A) and the NA one as full 45. That keeps total ops time reasonable.
